canonical_example.text: Musím přiznat, že jsem situaci podcenil.
canonical_example.translation: I have to admit I underestimated the situation.

canonical_example.text: Obžalovaný se nakonec přiznal.
canonical_example.translation: In the end the defendant confessed to the crime.

meanings.translation: to admit guilt, to plead guilty, to confess

canonical_example.text: Byla jim přiznána rozsáhlá práva.
canonical_example.translation: They were granted extensive rights.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to arrest, to detain (to take into legal custody)

canonical_example.text: Po nějaké době se zastavil na rozcestí.
canonical_example.translation: After a while he stopped at a crossroads.

meanings.translation: to stop, to halt, to pause

canonical_example.text: Už ti to došlo?
canonical_example.translation: Has it clicked already?

canonical_example.text: Červené víno došlo, už máme jen bílé.
canonical_example.translation: Red wine has run out, we only have white left.

canonical_example.text: Ty růže voní nádherně.
canonical_example.translation: The roses smell lovely.

meanings.translation: to smell, to have a pleasant smell

canonical_example.text: Potřebuji to ve větší velikosti.
canonical_example.translation: I need it in a bigger size.

canonical_example.text: Podařilo se mu vylézt na věž.
canonical_example.translation: He managed to climb the tower.

meanings.translation: to manage, to succeed (to succeed in an attempt)

canonical_example.text: Včera před snídaní užila svůj denní lék.
canonical_example.translation: She took her daily medicine before breakfast yesterday.

meanings.translation: (transitive) to use, to take of medicine [with accusative ‘something’; or with genitive ‘’] (higher register with genitive)

canonical_example.text: Včerejší návštěvu si užila.
canonical_example.translation: She enjoyed yesterday’s visit.

meanings.translation: to enjoy [with accusative ‘something’; or with genitive ‘’] (higher register with genitive)

canonical_example.text: získat postavení.
canonical_example.translation: to gain status.

canonical_example.text: Tahle stěna je postavená z bahna.
canonical_example.translation: This wall here is made of mud.

canonical_example.text: A když to postavil takto, konečně jsem pochopil, jak to myslí.
canonical_example.translation: And when he put it that way I could finally see what he meant.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to put (a question etc in a specific manner)
to tan (to change an animal hide into leather by soaking it in tannic acid)

canonical_example.text: Zemřel v šedesáti letech na infarkt.
canonical_example.translation: He died of a heart attack at the age of sixty.

canonical_example.text: Uzávěr menší cévy může vyvolat rozsáhlý infarkt.
canonical_example.translation: An obstruction of a small vessel can cause a large infarct.

canonical_example.text: Těch věcí jsem si ani nevšiml.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't even notice those things.

canonical_example.text: Jaký je to člověk? Dobrý.
canonical_example.translation: What kind of person is he? He's a good guy.

canonical_example.text: Jaká je vaše adresa?
canonical_example.translation: What is your address?

canonical_example.text: Nechť tě provází Síla.
canonical_example.translation: May the Force be with you.
